claim: Netflix hits record $3.0B in operating income in fiscal first quarter of 2025
summary: Q1 2025 operating income was a record but was about $3.34B, not $3.0B, so the stated $3.0B value is materially low.

sub_claims.text: Netflix operating income in fiscal first quarter of 2025 was $3.0B
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge Q1 2025 (Jan-Mar 2025) revenue ~$10.54B with 31.7% margin implies operating income ~$3.34-3.35B, not $3.0B; $3.0B understates actual by ~10-11% beyond rounding to $0.1B.

sub_claims.text: That Q1 2025 operating income was a record high
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge prior quarterly operating income peaked below $3.0B (e.g., ~$2.9B in Q3 2024), so Q1 2025 ~$3.3B+ was a new quarterly record at that time.
